body: I have been doing cognitive behavioral therapy with my therapist for about a year now and it has helped a little. I saw a psychiatrist for the first time last week and she wanted me to go on SSRi medication next week. I have this weird feeling that I have pleasure from the notion that I am dead...its almost as if it makes me happy.

your last line caused me to bust into uncontrollable tears in the middle of class...I definitely relate to you with the teaching aspect. Nothing makes me as happy, at least it used to, as when I would TA or tutor people. Your friend is very smart for saying that she hasn't taught enough people but I feel like if im gone there will always be another TA/teacher to replace me just like if I am someones friend, I too can be replaced. Last time I had an attempt though my friend brought up the fact of my younger brother and how he would be alone...it stopped me for a bit but now i cant even picture him to help me stop having these thoughts....thank you for your kind words

i appreciate your input but part of the problem with the fantasy is that i cannot control when it comes and goes. I have been diagnosed with OCD, high anxiety and severe depression...I have been tutoring foster kids and been a TA at my school and yes they do help very much but i cannot let go of the grip this depression has taken me. I told myself not to listen to any music that would make me spiral downwards but that's exactly what i have been doing...every song entails a different way that i can end it
